name: LEAKY CASTLE
description: GTIG says LEAKY CASTLE, a PRC contractor, overlaps with public reporting about data leaked from a contractor that used LLMs to analyze, translate and understand exfiltrated data, deriving insights into organizational structures that were added to finished intelligence reports sold to customers. *Analyst note: the LLM use and the sale of reports come from that public reporting (Wall Street Journal), which GTIG cites as overlapping; GTIG does not independently confirm them and gives no dates for LEAKY CASTLE. No MITRE IDs given (analyst-mapped). Vendor source.* GTIG
